reading.body:
Alexandria Paolozzi Moore is disclosed as a lobbyist on six AI-related filings, all filed through one firm, all naming FDD ACTION as the client.

The pattern is narrow and concentrated. Six filings, one firm, one client, and fourteen bills named across them, all dated 2025 or later. The disclosed prior government position is a 2010 internship in the office of Rep. Bill Posey, which the Lobbying Disclosure Act requires filers to list because it falls within the prior twenty years. That is the only government service in the record.

For AI specifically, this is a map of where one client's lobbying attention is going, not a measure of influence. The bills are named but their contents, subjects, and outcomes are not in the data. Nothing here shows whether any bill became law, whether the lobbying touched AI provisions specifically, or how much was spent.

The data also does not cover the other lobbyist sharing this name, who has a separate record. It says nothing about compute, data centers, or power, and it should not be read as evidence about them. What it establishes is a disclosure trail: who filed, for whom, and which bills were listed.

summary: Alexandria Paolozzi Moore is named as a lobbyist on 6 Lobbying Disclosure Act filing(s) about AI held by this site. The firms, clients and AI bills on those filings are below. LDA lobbyist id 152507. A different lobbyist with the same name has a separate page.
